title: Fourfold Structural Template: Locked Lemmas Comparing Missing-Sector Defect Delta_miss and Hodge Defect Delta_Hdg
description: Standalone mathematical specification (`README.md`, `INTEGRAL_HODGE.md`) proving the locked structural equivalence L <-> (Delta_miss = empty) for candidate cycle-spanning submodules on projective fourfolds, and establishing why L does not imply vanishing of the ambient Hodge defect Delta_Hdg = empty. Establishes logical boundary lemmas showing why local span closure L neither proves nor disproves the rational Hodge Conjecture. Copyright (c) 2026 Benjamin Stanley Frohman.
